basics.name: Royce Cornwell
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: I’m a software engineer with a background in Electrical Engineering, finishing my Computer Science degree in Berlin (graduating Q4 2026 / Q1 2027). I have professional experience with TypeScript and Kotlin, along with JavaScript, HTML5, and POSIX C through web and machine learning projects. During a recent software engineering internship, I took ownership of an ambiguous technical scope end-to-end — reconciling conflicting requirements, aligning stakeholders across two teams, and delivering a complete, engineering-ready backlog for a regulatory compliance project, while shipping full-stack features from the database layer through the UI. I care about practical problem-solving and clear documentation, and I enjoy working across the stack, whether that's backend, frontend, or full-stack.

education.institution: International University of Applied Science, Berlin, Germany

work.summary: Software engineering intern at Doctolib, working full-stack on e-prescription with the Clinical team and full-stack on patient intake with the Practice Operations team.
highlights: Owned technical scoping for an e-prescription print-layout migration end-to-end: reproduced current behavior, reconciled conflicting design and specification sources, and produced a complete, engineering-ready backlog with acceptance criteria
Investigated and resolved a data-access bug affecting a large volume of records, then delivered the underlying schema fix
Shipped full-stack features across TypeScript and Kotlin, including a new user-facing display and a new field threaded through the front end, backend, and PDF templating layer

Delivered independent backend work with the Practice Operations team on an unfamiliar codebase (Spring Boot / Kotlin / PostgreSQL), including a database migration and domain modeling with test-driven development
Wrote developer documentation adopted by the team and diagnosed and fixed local developer-tooling issues, sharing the fix with the wider team
Validated appointment-update behavior by querying the database directly, confirming that each change correctly produced its corresponding record

work.summary: Tutored for math subjects such as Calculus, Algebra
highlights: Built and tested GPS trackers for hummingbird research, with supporting documentation
Helped develop PCB libraries for a neurosurgical tool used in rodent brain research (Arduino).
